key_concepts: An electric circuit is a complete path of interconnected electrical components
A simple DC circuit has a power source, connector, load, and switch
Electric current flows only in a closed or complete circuit
Power sources include dry cells, batteries, generators, and solar cells
Copper, silver, and aluminum are good conductors of electricity
A load is an output device that uses electricity, such as a light bulb
A switch controls the flow of electricity by connecting or disconnecting the circuit
In a closed circuit the bulb lights because current flows from the source to the load and
In an open circuit a gap prevents current flow and the bulb does not light
Other causes of circuit breaks include drained or rusty batteries, wrong battery positions
A short circuit occurs when bare wires touch and current bypasses the load
Short circuits can overheat wires and cause appliance damage, electric shock, or fire
